source: res/globalmap/full: 256 tiles of 256x256, 8x8 pixels a cell
method: roughness of the photograph (smoothed mean absolute deviation of luminance) over 26 is rock; mean blue over mean red is water; cells the map tool painted over are filled in from their neighbours; settlement and tooltip cells are passable whatever the picture says

legend.,: dark smooth ground: lava field, wadi floor -- passable
legend.#: mountain, scarp, broken rock -- not passable
